pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion on the current-main task branch. This request tightens the Timeline persistence/track schema before production runtime composition: Animation uses stable motion-slot identity, first-release property paths are explicitly registered and type-checked, event/marker payloads are bounded, and Audio binding semantics are validated without introducing a Timeline-specific backend.

The PR remains Draft. Production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, dedicated Sequencer UI, Windows Validation and Visual Validation continue on this branch.
